route.first_use: Record one query and selected-item flow from the public terminal controls, review it, replay it in a fresh managed workspace and export only after success.
route.diagnosis: Change one screen expectation to an impossible value and require a useful bounded assertion failure with final rendered evidence.
route.maintenance: Change the query and its paired screen expectations through the documented selective /replace controls; preserve unrelated actions and replay.
route.relocation: Copy the complete exported project beneath a path with spaces and Unicode, then run the exact exported spec.
route.delivered_workflow: Generate and inspect a pinned source-build GitHub Actions preview; do not dispatch it as user CI.
